error.message: YouTube captions en->fr: YouTube answered HTTP 429 (automated-traffic block).
error.hint: YouTube is refusing requests from this IP address, which is common on cloud servers. Fixes, best first: run vid2context on your own machine; route the server through your home network (docs/guides/cloudflare-tunnel.md); set YOUTUBE_COOKIE to a signed-in Cookie header (ties requests to your account); or install the yt-dlp provider. Then wait for the block to clear (YOUTUBE_BLOCK_COOLDOWN_SEC).

attempts.detail: YouTube captions en->fr: YouTube answered HTTP 429 (automated-traffic block).

recovery.title: Download the audio and transcribe it
recovery.detail: POST /downloads with kind "audio", wait for the job, then upload the file (POST /uploads) and read GET /context?url=upload:<sha256>.

recovery.title: Paste or upload the transcript
recovery.detail: POST /imports with the transcript text or a subtitle file (.vtt, .srt, .txt); the result is a normal context.

recovery.title: Download it yourself and use the file
recovery.detail: Upload the file with POST /uploads, then read GET /context?url=upload:<sha256>.

recovery.title: Add a transcript API key
recovery.detail: Send SUPADATA_API_KEY with the request in the X-Vid2Context-Keys header (JSON object). The server uses it for that request only and never stores it.

keys.name: SUPADATA_API_KEY
keys.unlocks: YouTube transcripts fetched from Supadata servers, not this one

recovery.title: Try again later
recovery.detail: Blocks like this usually clear after a while.
